name: Heirloom Hamlet
note: Five-site family homestead off Carters Mill Rd near Ridgeland, minutes from I-95; booked through Hipcamp (Good Sam members request through the website). No-hookup RV site $33, water/electric $44, full hookup $55 (2026). Outdoor shower and a separating dry toilet, no conventional bathhouse - the hosts say plainly it is a homestead, not a traditional campground. Good Sam Park. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: heirloomhamlet.com live ('Reserve through Hipcamp'); Hipcamp listing instant-bookable, 5 RV/van sites up to 45 ft, 98% over 179+239 ratings; Google 4.9 over 37; cheapest hookup site (water/electric) $44/night, read by AWH 2026-10-01 - passes the $50 published-rate gate (unrated default-$ park); small homestead accepted by AWH 2026-10-01
